source.title: Collective model description of transitional odd-A nuclei (II)
source.author: J. Meyer-ter-Vehn

claims.claim: Fixed beta/gamma rigid triaxial shapes are an approximation to actual nuclear wavefunctions.
claims.boundary: Model success does not measure the absence of shape fluctuations.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Goal is nearly correct level order below 2Δ and smooth systematic trends; quantitative agreement is not expected.
claims.boundary: Do not transfer the calculation to unrestricted high-spin/multiquasiparticle states.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Beta/gamma fluctuations are proposed to compress spectra and affect transition probabilities; experimental spectra are compressed relative to calculations in all examples discussed.
claims.boundary: Softness attribution is an interpretation; no fluctuation amplitude is measured here.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Coriolis attenuation, odd-particle polarization, pair blocking, other-j-shell mixing and three-or-more-quasiparticle configurations are omitted or approximate.
claims.boundary: Single-j comparison cannot independently rule these alternatives out.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Gamma is obtained from the second 2+ relative to the nearest ground-band member, usually first 4+; particle spectra choose A−1, holes A+1.
claims.boundary: Author justifies selection by the same number of unbroken particle/hole pairs; the rule is conditional on particle/hole identification.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Even-core spectra are symmetric under gamma↔60°−gamma; the side of 30° is selected using the odd-A spectrum.
claims.boundary: Gamma side is not an independent prediction from even-core ratios.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Beta uses the average first-2+ energy of both even neighbors: beta=sqrt[1224 X(gamma)/(A^(7/3) Ebar_2+)], Ebar in MeV.
claims.boundary: This averaging rule differs from the one-neighbor gamma choice and is acknowledged as an empirical compromise.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.boundary: These are irrotational-rotor model ratios, not measured energies.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Lambda_F is estimated from an axial Nilsson diagram; when it penetrates the j shell it is fine-adjusted by approximately fitting the first (j−1) odd-A state.
claims.boundary: The term essentially parameter-free does not mean every parameter is target-data independent.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Figures2–9 use dimensionless scaled lambda: particles (lambda_F−epsilon1)/(epsilon2−epsilon1); holes (epsilon_(j+1/2)−lambda_F)/(epsilon_(j+1/2)−epsilon_(j−1/2)).
claims.boundary: Do not identify plotted lambda with a MeV-valued chemical potential or transfer its zero to WK22.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Delta_gamma is the largest difference between the standard gamma and gamma from other Table1 ratios, not a statistical standard deviation. Only Os permits better than1° precision; heavy Pt is near30° with side uncertain.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 187Ir h9/2 proton-particle spectrum uses186Os gamma≈16°; h11/2 proton-hole spectrum uses188Pt gamma24°; Au h9/2 particles use Pt and h11/2 holes Hg; Tl h9/2 particles use Hg.
claims.boundary: The two negative-parity families in the same odd nucleus need not share identical effective core parameters.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Overall compression is the largest systematic discrepancy and is said not removable by fitting free parameters or varying standard uncertainties; author links it to core softness.
claims.boundary: Supports useful fixed-shape approximation with missing dynamics, not a proof of gamma rigidity.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 199Tl h9/2 calculation explicitly increases beta from198Hg .13 to .15 to improve agreement; gamma37°, scaled lambda−.5 and Δ=.7MeV.
claims.boundary: Odd-particle deforming effect is the author interpretation; beta .15 is an exception to standard inputs.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 199Tl energies are relative to the basic state, experimental0(+748keV); Q=−2.4eb and mu=3.3 nuclear magnetons shown are calculated basic-state moments.
claims.boundary: They are not newly measured static moments, nor is the plotted zero the nuclear ground state.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Unobserved low-spin states and some experimental/model identifications in199Tl are predictions or tentative assignments.
claims.boundary: Do not count proposed states as confirmed levels.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 195Au h11/2 hole on oblate Hg reproduces decoupled order; calculated displayed intensities use calculated B(E2)/B(M1) with experimental transition energies when known.
claims.boundary: Rates incorporate observed kinematics; they are not a completely independent forward prediction or raw B ratios.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 195Au beta .144 is used instead of standard .141 to improve relative transition rates, particularly the second11/2 state near a structure interchange.
claims.boundary: A local beta adjustment is not a globally refitted or independently measured shape.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Final-energy order575,560,207,0keV: experiment52,3,11,34%; theory beta.144:57,8,15,20%; beta.141:4,25,11,40%.
claims.boundary: The printed beta.141 column sums80%; visual enlargement confirms4. Leave normalization/typographical issue unresolved; do not silently renormalize.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Final-energy order575,560,207,0keV: experiment34,49,blank,17%; theory beta.144:33,38,1,28%; beta.141:39,35,2,24%.
claims.boundary: Blank experimental207keV branch is not a zero measurement.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Additional195Au negative-parity states are tentatively attributed to a separate h9/2 family, conditional on the interpretation of their spins/decays.
claims.boundary: Do not place every additional negative-parity state in h11/2 automatically.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 193Hg i13/2 neutron-hole decoupled yrast order is reproduced both at gamma38° beta.13 and axial gamma60° beta.11; scaled lambda1.0 and Δ=.7MeV.
claims.boundary: Yrast decoupled order alone is not unique triaxiality evidence; the compared beta values also differ.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Second19/2 state is invoked for additional triaxial evidence, but its experimental parity is uncertain; reduced yrast gamma sensitivity is partly attributed to lambda inside the shell.
claims.boundary: Retain parity ambiguity and Fermi-position dependence.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 187Ir h9/2 uses beta.23 gamma16.2° scaled lambda0 Δ=.7MeV; h11/2 Fig6 uses beta.21 gamma24° scaled lambda.42 Δ=.7MeV.
claims.boundary: Beta.21 is the prescribed neighbor average; gamma values derive from different reference cores.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Experimental187Ir states are tentatively arranged by energy/decay against approximate (Kbar,Omegabar) columns; h9/2 favored/unfavored level order is nearly reproduced.
claims.boundary: Approximate labels are not exact good quantum numbers or secure experimental band identities.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Some higher predicted low-spin states have calculated decays agreeing much less or not at all with unassigned experimental levels.
claims.boundary: Keep this failure alongside successful level-order comparisons.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Experimental enhanced B(E2;7/2−→11/2−)≈.3(e b)^2 is quoted for189Ir; calculated187Ir value is .31(e b)^2.
claims.boundary: Related-isotope support must not be relabeled a same-state187Ir measurement.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: 187Ir h11/2 B(E2) ratios (in table row order) are experiment1.7(+infinity,−1.4), .8(+.2,−.6), <.1, 1.3(+3.1,−.6); theory7.07,.86,.02,1.37.
claims.boundary: Broad/asymmetric bounds permit the first large theory value; this is not precision agreement. Transitions are transcribed separately in report.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Measured transition energies are used to calculate theoretical delta(E2/M1).
claims.boundary: Mixing-ratio comparison includes experimental E_gamma input.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.boundary: Literal interval check: rows1,3 inside; rows2,4,5 outside. Do not invent confidence levels, fit uncertainty, or chi-square.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Bands are strongly mixed with generally weak (Kbar,Omegabar) character; in-band transitions may be weaker than links to neighboring/yrast bands.
claims.boundary: Rotational character does not imply a clean experimentally identifiable band; no chiral doublet is established by this argument.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment

claims.claim: Within read pages, the paper supports phenomenological triaxial particle-rotor comparisons with calibrated core/Fermi inputs and explicit failures.
claims.boundary: It does not provide a microscopic chiral test, a WK22 h11/2/pairing/shape fit, or an independent133Ce inference. PDF13 ends mid§3.1.5; PDF14–25 were not read in this unit.
claims.lineage: MTV75-II theory/comparison; measurements inherited from cited experimental references, not a new experiment
